timecoded_text_to_speech.text: People keep asking, is that proof of God?
Can you prove the existence of God?
Every religion struggles to prove the existence of God.
All the Eastic religions struggle to prove the existence of God.
None of them struggle to prove your existence.
It's beyond question. Nobody asks the question,
do I exist? You might ask, does my body really exist?
Does my mind really exist? But do I exist?
There's no need to prove that.
In fact, we shall see later, how Brahman, the Vedantic concept of God, in a Brahman,
also does not require any proof. It's self-proved.
Swami in Uttarakhand in the Himalayas asked a question to the Vedanta teacher.
Swami in the East work, he assured us that in the Akad, he would give me an irrefutable proof of the existence of God.
And the immediate answer was your own existence.
